name: description
value: If your Final beats your lower midterm, it replaces half of that midterm.

name: Cutoffs
value: The syllabus only guarantees at least an A− at 90 and a B− at 80, then says etc., so C− at 70 and D− at 60 are assumed. Other letters are set at the end of the semester.

name: Homework
value: Enter your homework average after the two lowest are dropped. The syllabus doesn't give the number of assignments.

name: Quizzes
value: Weekly group quizzes are one average percent, since no count or drop is given.

name: Final replacement
value: The Final replaces 10% of the 20% from your lower midterm. With 50 and 80 on the midterms and 90 on the Final, the 50 effectively becomes 70.
